name: Takayasu Arteritis
definition: Chronic granulomatous large-vessel vasculitis affecting the aorta and major branches, commonly in younger women.

investigations.principle: CTA/MRA/PET and inflammatory markers are used according to disease phase.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Urgent rheumatology/vascular care when active or ischemic
amber: Immunosuppression and revascularization timing require specialist coordination.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Rakta-vaha/Srotas vascular phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Chronic granulomatous large-vessel vasculitis affecting the aorta and major branches, commonly in younger women.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
